title: Retitle a book without changing it
prompt: Write `retitle(book: Book, title: string): Book`. Return a new `Book` with the same `id` and the new `title`, even when the title is empty. The `book` passed in must keep its old title.
hints: Build a separate object instead of assigning to `book.title`.
`{ ...book, title }` copies every field, then replaces `title`.
checks: (() => { const t = { id: 7, title: "Dune" }; const n = retitle(t, "Emma"); return t.title === "Dune" && n !== t; })()

wrongAnswers.misconception: Assigns to `book.title`, so the caller's book changes too.
Builds a new object but drops the original `id`.
